Maria G: Heads-up — candidate Noor Hamdi arriving Tue 2026-04-07 09:30 PT for the ML Eng onsite loop. Two asks: 1) guest badge pre-registration + lobby escort, 2) loaner Mac imaged and VPN-ready by 9:15. Candidate is vegan and has a nut allergy. Also needs a quiet room for a 1:1 at ~11:15.

Taylor P: I can meet them in the lobby and escort up. Where should I pick them up?

Maria G: Thanks Taylor — lobby main entrance, tell them to ask for "Redwood reception". Please add escort name on the prereg form.

Alex K: IT Support here — we have a cleared MacBook Air (loaner-12) available. I'll image it early morning. Can you DM candidate email so I can pre-create the account?

Maria G: Sending email in a sec: noor.hamdi+candidate@example.com. FrontDeskBot, can you pre-register and print a visitor badge with "Redwood-Visitor" sticker? Candidate will show passport.

FrontDeskBot: Visitor preregistration submitted. badge_code=RV-4769. Please include escort name on the form. PDF prereg uploaded to #people-ops-uploads (link).

Emma L: Quick scheduling update — I can cover the first two interviews and escort if needed. Also Raj can't make the 13:00 system-design slot; can Jenna cover?

Taylor P: Jenna is available, I just confirmed. I'll update the invite.

Maria G: Thanks. Expense note: if candidate needs travel reimbursement, send receipts to expenses@redwood.com with code CAND-TRAVEL-2026. Parking validation code is "VIP-PARK" — front desk will validate.

Alex K: Imaging notes for IT team — running this will set up the candidate profile and VPN:

```bash
sudo /opt/redwood/image_setup.sh --preset=candidate --vpn --no-ssh-key
```

IT Support: Copy — I'll image and run VPN test. ETA 08:00.

Taylor P: I'll be in lobby at 9:15 to meet Noor. :thumbsup:

Maria G: Catering — candidate dietary restrictions: vegan + nut allergy. @Sam P can you order boxed lunch labeled nut-free and reserve quiet room 4A from 11:00-12:00?

Sam P: Ordered vegan boxed lunches labeled "Noor — nut-free" and reserved Quiet Room 4A for 11:00-12:00. Catering confirmation emailed to Maria.

FrontDeskBot: Badge printed. Escort assigned: Taylor P.

Alex K: Imaging complete at 07:50. Username created: noor.hamdi+candidate@example.com. VPN test successful. MacBook assigned loaner-12.

Maria G: Perfect — closing the loop. If anything changes, reply here.

Emma L: Thanks team — I added Jenna to the calendar invite and updated the panel notes. See you tomorrow.
